MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 12x
   D. 6x + 2

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 77
   C. 22
   D. 18

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 14
   C. 12
   D. 10

4. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 5

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. 1/2
   D. They are equal

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 1
   D. 2

8. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 13
   D. 5

9. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 72
   B. 73
   C. 1
   D. 17

10. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.205
   C. 2.5
   D. 0.25

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 44

   D. 22

12. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15

   A. 170

   C. 26

   A. 18

   D. 90

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48

   D. 156

16. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

17. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400

   C. 40
